greeting: You're wheels-up this evening for the Croatia sailing trip, Dan — a long night of flying, Frankfurt at dawn, and Dubrovnik by midday tomorrow. The girls are with Jen through the 21st, so the next two weeks are yours and Mike's.

needsAttention.title: Kerrie's waiting on the AI paper
needsAttention.detail: Kerrie Waring replied to your whistleblower document asking for the AI paper you referred to. A two-minute send from the lounge closes it before you drop offline.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat hotel for Sept 19 still open
needsAttention.detail: The last night after the charter isn't booked, and you go dark once aboard on the 12th. Lock the Cavtat room and the noon transfer while you still have signal.

needsAttention.title: St Pete nights of Sept 20-21
needsAttention.detail: You land back in Tampa Sept 20 but the girls' pickup isn't until the 22nd. The two-night landing-gap lodging is still pending.

inbox.noise: Just a Patreon teaser, a SiriusXM offer, an airline baggage receipt, and past Airbnb confirmations - nothing that needs you.

resolved.title: Croatia bags checked through
resolved.detail: Discover Airlines confirmed your baggage is checked in for the Tampa-Dubrovnik flight, so the allowance question is settled.

recipe.title: Butternut squash & candied bacon on fresh pasta
recipe.why: Early autumn is peak winter-squash season, when its sweetness pairs beautifully with something salty and rich.

tasks.title: Decide Halloween - St Pete or Maine

acts.line: The last quiet hours on the ground before a long day of flying.
Into Tampa for the 5:55 departure - the trip proper starts at the gate.
Overnight to Frankfurt, then the Dubrovnik connection lands you in Croatia by midday tomorrow.
